outcome_evidence: The drawer is initially closed in frame 0 (image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches and closes its gripper around the upper drawer handle at frames 75–80 (wrist_image), then pulls the drawer outward at frames 91–107, visibly exposing its interior and side (image and left_ego_image). The robot releases and withdraws at frames 111–134 while the drawer remains open (image and left_ego_image). No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visible.
